outcome: Adverse neonatal outcome (neonatal mortality, 5-minute Apgar <7, and/or neonatal intensive care unit admission)
cohort: 755,198 women delivering at term of a singleton without congenital malformations
finding: Infants born at 37 weeks of gestation had a significantly higher risk of intrapartum/neonatal mortality and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to those born at 39-41 weeks, particularly if labor started spontaneously.
